compiled_state.title: Implement aws-verify-live.sh — 7-check live AWS verification (RED test + GREEN impl)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: 7 distinct checks consuming review_telemetry.* keys
- dd-2: All pass → exit 0; any fail → exit non-zero + per-check status
- dd-3: Missing review_telemetry.* key → exit 1 + named missing-key message
- dd-4: After teardown → exit non-zero + per-check absent status + ≤5s POST timeout (not hung)

## Approach
Mirror sibling pattern: plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-status.sh + aws-teardown.sh. Monolithic bash with 7 named check functions, shared `_aws()` wrapper (honors DSO_AWS_CMD), `_read_config()` (honors DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD), fail-fast pre-loop on missing keys.

## 7 Check Functions
1. check_lambda_function_url — `lambda get-function-url-config`
2. check_iam_role_trust — `iam get-role` + trust policy includes lambda.amazonaws.com
3. check_s3_head_bucket — `s3api head-bucket`
4. check_s3_encryption — `s3api get-bucket-encryption` + assert SSE
5. check_s3_lifecycle — `s3api get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration` + assert ≥1 transition rule
6. check_iam_simulate_principal — `iam simulate-principal-policy` action s3:PutObject → EvalDecision=allowed
7. check_e2e_post_visibility — POST to Lambda URL; poll bucket with backoff 1,2,4,8,15,30s (60s budget)

## Invariants
- ALL aws calls via `_aws()` wrapper (DSO_AWS_CMD override)
- ALL `_aws ...` calls wrapped in `timeout 5` (DD-4 ≤5s ceiling)
- Config via `_read_config()` (DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD override)
- Fail-fast: any missing review_telemetry.* key → exit 1 + stderr "ERROR: review_telemetry.<KEY> is not set"
- Poll-backoff: EXACT schedule 1,2,4,8,15,30s (sum 60s); NOT single-shot
- main() invokes all 7 sequentially; prints `<check_name>: ok` or `<check_name>: FAIL <reason>`; exits 0 iff all pass
- set -euo pipefail; ShellCheck-clean
- ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/ for self-refs, never literal plugins/dso/

## Test Cases (tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh)
1. t_all_checks_pass_exits_0
2. t_iam_trust_missing_exits_nonzero
3. t_missing_bucket_name_key_exits_1_named (CONJUNCTION #1)
4. t_missing_function_name_key_exits_1_named (CONJUNCTION #2)
5. t_missing_role_name_key_exits_1_named (CONJUNCTION #3)
6. t_teardown_absent_exits_nonzero_within_5s_per_check (wall-clock SECONDS/date measurement)
7. t_e2e_post_uses_backoff_schedule (≥3 polls, increasing gaps)
8. t_aws_calls_use_dso_aws_cmd_wrapper
9. t_post_visibility_absent_resource_completes_under_5s (budget exhausted, NOT hung)

Use `mktemp -d /tmp/aws-verify-live-test.XXXXXX` (no -t flag — macOS/GNU divergence).

## Sibling-Pattern Reference (READ FIRST)
- plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-status.sh
- tests/scripts/test-aws-status.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] aws-verify-live.sh exists, executable, set -euo pipefail
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh && head -5 plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail'
- [ ] ShellCheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] All 7 named check functions defined
  Verify: for fn in check_lambda_function_url check_iam_role_trust check_s3_head_bucket check_s3_encryption check_s3_lifecycle check_iam_simulate_principal check_e2e_post_visibility; do grep -qE "^${fn}\\(\\)" plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh || exit 1; done
- [ ] Test file exists, executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] All 9 tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] CONJUNCTION AC #1 (bucket_name missing-key test)
  Verify: grep -q 't_missing_bucket_name_key_exits_1_named' tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] CONJUNCTION AC #2 (function_name missing-key test)
  Verify: grep -q 't_missing_function_name_key_exits_1_named' tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] CONJUNCTION AC #3 (role_name missing-key test)
  Verify: grep -q 't_missing_role_name_key_exits_1_named' tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] Teardown-absent test asserts wall-clock measurement (SECONDS or date +%s)
  Verify: grep -E 'SECONDS|date \+%s' tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] Backoff schedule test defined
  Verify: grep -q 't_e2e_post_uses_backoff_schedule' tests/scripts/test-aws-verify-live.sh
- [ ] All _aws invocations wrapped in timeout 5
  Verify: AWS=$(grep -cE '_aws ' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh); TO=$(grep -cE 'timeout 5 _aws|timeout 5 "?\$\{?_AWS' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh); [ "$AWS" -gt 0 ] && [ "$TO" -ge "$AWS" ]
- [ ] No literal plugins/dso/ in non-CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT comments
  Verify: ! grep -E '^# .*plugins/dso/' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-verify-live.sh | grep -v 'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
